Arjun Patel | Ahmedabad, Gujarat | arjun.patel.mern@example.com | github.com/arjunp-example

EDUCATION
B.E., Computer Engineering, Sabarmati Institute of Engineering, Ahmedabad (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.3/10

INTERNSHIP
Web Developer Intern, Sabarmati Web Studio, Ahmedabad (May 2025 - Jul 2025, 10 weeks)
- Built React components for a restaurant booking site, including a date picker and booking form.
- Added Express.js REST API endpoints in Node.js for creating and cancelling bookings.
- Used Git branches and pull requests on GitHub for every feature with code review by the lead.

PROJECTS
- CampusKart (personal): Built a MERN marketplace where students sell used books; stored listings and users in MongoDB with Mongoose.
- Portfolio site: Designed a responsive portfolio with HTML, CSS and Flexbox that scores 95 on Lighthouse.
- Quiz app (academic, Web Technologies course): Wrote vanilla JavaScript for a timed quiz app with local scores as part of the Web Technologies course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Data Structures and Algorithms, DBMS, Web Technologies, Operating Systems, Computer Networks
- freeCodeCamp Responsive Web Design certification

SKILLS
JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, HTML, CSS, Git, TypeScript (learning), Data Structures and Algorithms (C++)

ACTIVITIES
- Solved 300+ problems on LeetCode
- Organised the college hackathon website team
